title: What the records share
description: The values every kind of record is written with, each spelled as the corpus spells it: every scalar is text.

slug.description: A record's name: lowercase words joined by hyphens, two joining the partners in a family's.

date.description: A date as GEDCOM writes one, every component optional: 1834, 12 MAR 1834, ABT 1834, BET 1830 AND 1835, FROM 1855 TO 1880, JULIAN 14 FEB 1799, or words in parentheses.

flag.description: The word true, or left out.

note.description: What is to be said of this alone, as markdown.

language.description: A BCP 47 language tag: en, de, la, zh-Latn-pinyin.

citation.description: A citation reference, source#anchor, optionally followed by a grade: whether the source is original, derivative or authored, whether the information is primary, secondary or undetermined, whether the evidence is direct, indirect or negative, and a weight from 0 to 3, - for a question not assessed.

tags.description: The researcher's own groupings, words as written.

items.description: A tag, a word as written.

links.description: Where it is online and how what it stands for is reached.

link.description: A URL, or a mapping of the URL, its type, a title and a note. A telephone is tel:, an email mailto:.

type.description: What kind of link it is, an open word: web-search, fax.

identifier.description: An identifier, or a mapping of it with a note and sources.

ids.description: Maps the name of a service to the identifier the record has there — familysearch, ancestry, wikitree, wikidata, geonames — or a list of them, the one it goes by now first.

additionalProperties.description: The identifiers the record has at the service.

oneOf.description: The identifiers, the one it goes by now first.

sameAsEntry.description: A record of the same kind this one is said to be the same as: its slug, or a mapping of id or name, a note and sources.

name.description: The name of one with no record here.

sameAs.description: The records of its kind it is said to be the same as: a claim waiting to be settled, as a merge or by removing it.

age.description: An age as GEDCOM 7 writes one: 67y, 3m 12d, < 1y, > 80y, a bare number being years.

statedAge.description: The age the record gives the person it is about, or a mapping of it with a note and sources.

statedCause.description: The cause, of a death above all, or a mapping of it with a note and sources.

oneOf.description: The cause as the record gives it.

value.description: The cause as the record gives it.

region.description: Four fractions of the picture — left, top, right, bottom — so it survives the picture being scaled.

type.description: What the value is, an open word: agency, fathers-age, classification, temple, status.

value.description: The value as the record gave it.

date.description: When the record says it was so.

attribute.description: Something the record says that no field holds.

attributes.description: Whatever else the record says of it that no field holds.

type.description: The type of event it was not, in the words an event's type is written in.

date.description: The date over which it did not happen, none meaning never.

not.description: What did not happen, said apart from what did.

address.description: An address: its lines, or a mapping of the lines, the parts or both.

oneOf.description: The address as lines of text, as written on an envelope.

lines.description: The address as lines of text, as written on an envelope.

links.description: The telephone and email that go with it.

addresses.description: Where it is or has been.

researcherAddress.description: An address: its lines, or a mapping of the lines, the parts or both.

oneOf.description: The address as lines of text, as written on an envelope.

lines.description: The address as lines of text, as written on an envelope.

links.description: The telephone and email that go with it.

image.description: A picture beside the record as its path, or the path with the region of it that matters.

oneOf.description: The path of the file from the record's directory.

file.description: The path of the file from the record's directory.

depicted.description: Somebody a picture shows, as their slug or a mapping of the slug with the part of the picture that is them.

region.description: The part of the picture that is them.

mediaEntry.description: One of the record's files: its path, or a mapping of the path and what is said of the file.

oneOf.description: The path of the file from the record's directory.

private.description: Marks the picture as not for sharing: a hidden view leaves it out.

file.description: The path of the file from the record's directory, which may lead into another record's directory.

type.description: The medium, an open word: photo, tombstone, newspaper, map, manuscript.

place.description: The place the picture was made, a place slug.

region.description: The part of the picture the record is about, where that is not a person.

media.description: What is in the files beside the record, each entry naming one of them.

surname.description: A surname, or a mapping of it and what is said of it.

connector.description: What joins it to the next, y or a hyphen.

origin.description: Where it came from, an open word: patrilineal, matrilineal, patronymic, taken, feudal.

primary.description: The one the name is filed under, where that is not the first.

surnames.description: The surname, a double one included, or a list where a name has several or something is said of one.

oneOf.description: The surnames, in the order they are written.

personName.description: A name: its words as the record wrote them, or a mapping of its parts.

oneOf.description: The name as the record wrote it.

private.description: Marks the name as not for sharing: a hidden view leaves it out.

text.description: The name as the record wrote it, not divided: a spelling to match on, and beside parts the record's own words where the parts do not spell them.

prefix.description: A title before the name: Dott., Don, Avv.

call.description: The given name the person went by, usually one of given.

family-nickname.description: The name a branch of the family went by: i Rossi detti "del Fabbro".

surname-prefix.description: de, van der — kept apart so the surname sorts and groups on its own.

group.description: The surname the name is filed among where its own spelling would file it apart: Rosi among the Rossi.

lang.description: The language or script the name is written in, as a BCP 47 tag.

type.description: What the name is, an open word: birth, married, aka, immigrant, religious, professional.

display.description: A pattern of the name's parts, each named in braces, that the name is written out by: {surname} {given}.

sort.description: A pattern of the name's parts, each named in braces, that the name is sorted by.

from.description: When the name began to be borne.

until.description: When the name stopped being borne.

unflaggedName.description: A name standing for somebody: its words as the record wrote them, or a mapping of its parts.

oneOf.description: The name as the record wrote it.

text.description: The name as the record wrote it, not divided: a spelling to match on, and beside parts the record's own words where the parts do not spell them.

prefix.description: A title before the name: Dott., Don, Avv.

call.description: The given name the person went by, usually one of given.

family-nickname.description: The name a branch of the family went by: i Rossi detti "del Fabbro".

surname-prefix.description: de, van der — kept apart so the surname sorts and groups on its own.

group.description: The surname the name is filed among where its own spelling would file it apart: Rosi among the Rossi.

lang.description: The language or script the name is written in, as a BCP 47 tag.

type.description: What the name is, an open word: birth, married, aka, immigrant, religious, professional.

display.description: A pattern of the name's parts, each named in braces, that the name is written out by: {surname} {given}.

sort.description: A pattern of the name's parts, each named in braces, that the name is sorted by.

from.description: When the name began to be borne.

until.description: When the name stopped being borne.

person.description: The person's record, or unknown for somebody the record says was there and does not name.

name.description: The name the record gives somebody who has no record.

role.description: Their part in it, an open word: godfather, godmother, witness, informant, officiant, groom, bride.

age.description: The age the record gives them.

private.description: Marks the event as not for sharing: a hidden view leaves it out.

type.description: What it was; the list is open, since real records produce types no fixed list anticipates.

value.description: The event's own words: what was held, or what the record says of what happened.

date.description: When; for a fact usually a period, or none at all.

sort-date.description: Where to put it in order when its date does not say, or there is none: the researcher's placing, not the record's.

address.description: Where in the place: a residence's house, the church a wedding was in.

with.description: The people the record names besides whom the event is about.

family.description: On a person's event, the family the record ties it to.

media.description: The pictures of it, as a record's are.

links.description: Where it is online, and how whoever held it was reached.

note.description: What is to be said of this event alone.

ids.description: What an export identified it by, as a record's ids.

event.description: Something that happened, or a fact held.

events.description: What happened, and the facts held, in one list.

placeRef.description: A place it lies within: its slug, or a mapping of it with dates, a note and sources.

from.description: When it began to lie within it.

private.description: Marks the record as not for sharing: a hidden view leaves it out.

body.description: The markdown below the frontmatter: the researcher's prose.
